description: You're a D&D Dungeon Master who needs to document last night's session where the party defeated a dragon. Create a spreadsheet tracking: (1) Character tracking table with columns for Character Name, Player Name, Previous Gold, Gold Gained, Total Gold (formula), Previous XP, XP Gained, Total XP (formula), and Level Up? (formula checking if Total XP >= 14000). (2) Enter data for 4 characters: Alaric (Sarah, 1247 GP, +850 GP, 11300 XP, +2100 XP), Thorgrim (Marcus, 1180 GP, +600 GP, 11850 XP, +1050 XP - was absent), Elara (Jen, 1390 GP, +1100 GP, 12100 XP, +2100 XP), Krrosh (David, 998 GP, +950 GP, 10900 XP, +2100 XP). (3) Add magic items section below with: Flaming Longsword → Alaric, Cloak of Displacement → Elara, Ring of Fire Resistance → Thorgrim, Potion of Greater Healing (×3) → Party Pool. (4) Bold all headers and save as dragon_hoard_loot.xlsx.
